# European Union Official Website

> > Official information on the European Union's institutions, policies, member states, and actions across economic, social, and international domains.

This is the primary informational portal for the European Union, covering its 27 member states, key institutions (European Parliament, European Commission, Council of the EU, European Central Bank), the euro currency, budget and funding mechanisms including NextGenerationEU, and policy actions ranging from regional development to international cooperation. The site serves as the authoritative source for understanding EU principles, values, and current initiatives including support for Ukraine and COVID-19 recovery.

## Key Topics

- European Union institutions
- European Parliament
- European Commission
- Council of the EU
- European Central Bank (ECB)
- Euro currency and Eurozone
- Schengen Area
- NextGenerationEU recovery fund
- EU member states and enlargement
- EU budget and cohesion funding
- Regional policy and investment
- Sustainable Development Goals
- Copenhagen criteria
- Parliamentary republics
- EU values: democracy, rule of law, human dignity

## Core EU Principles and Actions

- [Aims and values](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/principles-and-values/aims-and-values_en): EU founding values: human dignity, democracy, rule of law & equality
- [EU actions by topic](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic_en): Directory of EU policy actions organized by topic area
- [EU support for Ukraine](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/eu-support-ukraine_en): EU aid for Ukraine: humanitarian, military, economic & reconstruction support
- [EU response to COVID-19](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/common-eu-response-covid-19_en): EU COVID-19 recovery: NextGenerationEU, vaccines & digital certificates
- [EU enlargement](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-enlargement_en): EU membership process: Copenhagen criteria & accession negotiations

## Budget and Economic Policy

- [The Euro](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/euro_en): Euro currency: history, eurozone countries & European Central Bank management
- [Managing the euro](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/euro/managing-euro_en): European Central Bank manages euro monetary policy & currency production
- [Budget – revenue](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/budget/how-eu-budget-financed_en): EU budget revenue sources: GNI, customs duties, VAT & NextGenerationEU bonds
- [EU budget, spending](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/budget/how-eu-budget-spent_en): EU budget spending: multiannual framework & annual allocation process
- [Regional policy and investment](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/regional-policy_en): EU regional policy for economic growth, jobs, transport & climate action

## Policy Areas and Programs

- [Sustainable development – EU action](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/development-and-cooperation_en): EU international partnerships for UN Sustainable Development Goals
- [Cultural heritage and the arts – EU support](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/culture_en): EU cultural support via Creative Europe & European Capitals of Culture

## EU Member States

- [Netherlands – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/netherlands_en): Netherlands profile: parliamentary monarchy in Euro & Schengen areas
- [Italy – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/italy_en): Italy profile: parliamentary republic in Eurozone & Schengen areas
- [Hungary– EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/hungary_en): Hungary profile: parliamentary republic in Schengen, uses Hungarian Forint
- [Slovakia – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/slovakia_en): Slovakia profile: parliamentary republic in Euro & Schengen areas
- [Lithuania – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/lithuania_en): Lithuania profile: parliamentary republic in Euro & Schengen areas

## History and Archives

- [Historical archives of EU institutions](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu/historical-archives-eu-institutions_en): Search EU institutional archives at European University Institute Florence
- [Flying the EU flag for 40 years!](https://european-union.europa.eu/news-and-events/news-and-stories/flying-eu-flag-40-years-2025-06-27_en): EU flag 40th anniversary: symbol of unity & solidarity since 1985

## Optional
